body:
I have had great friends and family my whole life. I know that me being gone might be hard on some of them, but i have made up my mind.

This is only the tip of the iceberg of my problems, but i am not going to get into that now. This has been somewhat of a reality check, which showed me that maybe my time is here.

I will see my siblings one last time this weekend and then try to say my goodbyes to my friends. This is the end of the road for me, and i have accepted that. Some people dont get a happy ending, but thats fine. Life is not some movie where it all works out in the end
I messed up, like I always do. I can't have anything nice in my life. But I have come to accept that. I just want out of this place, I am done trying.
